scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application, ID LOAN-01555, has been originated.

dialogue.user: Okay, that's good to hear. Can you tell me if my application was approved? And if so, what is my interest rate and the total cost of the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application was approved, and the loan has been originated. The interest rate for your loan is 6.5%, and the total loan costs are $4,502.51.

dialogue.user: Okay, thank you for that information. Can you tell me what my loan term is and if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The loan term is 360 months. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying that. So, to confirm, my loan has been approved with a 6.5% interest rate over 360 months, and there are no HOEPA or negative amortization flags. Has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan has been sold to Fannie Mae.

dialogue.user: Thank you for all the information. I think I have everything I need. <Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the interaction because you were able to answer all my questions clearly and promptly.
